full_judgment: 3. Short facts of the case, are that the property in question was sold in auction for arrear rents in LR Sale Case No.1217 of 1952-53. One Abdul Latif Prodhan purchased the property in auction and got delivery of possession on 5-6-1955. Property under CS Khatian No.64 was in possession of one Bipin Behari Singh who refused to obtain settlement of the same on payment of rents to Abdul Latif Prodhan, consequently, the property was made khas by Abdul Latif Prodhan. In the way aforesaid Abdul Latif Prodhan while in possession and enjoyment of the property sold out a portion of the auction purchased property to the father of the plaintiff, Abul Khayrat Bhuiyan by a Registered Sale Deed No.4695 dated 22-6-1955. After death of Abul Khayrat Bhuiyan the plaintiffs as heirs acquired the property by inheritance and have been possessing the same in different ways by cultivating seasonal crops and rearing fishes in the low land. The defendants have had no title and possession in the property, but SA and RS khatians stood recorded in the name of vendors of the defendants who had no title and possession in the property. When the plaintiffs went to local Tahshil Office for payment of rents and mutation of their names, concerned officials refused to receive rent on the ground that khatian for the property stands in the name of defendant. Consequently, the plaintiff filed Title Suit No.332 of 2015 in the Court of Joint District Judge, 2nd Court, Narayanganj for declaration of title and correction of the khatian against the government and others which is now pending for disposal.
